selection.source: Nasdaq stock screener + Alpaca daily bars
selection.classification: US common stock; new healthcare, biotech and pharma excluded; curated exceptions

rules.kind: SpicyStock numeric proxy; manual chart review required

measurement_rules.scan: close / previous session close >= 1.04; volume > previous session volume; volume >= 100000
measurement_rules.breadth: same volume rules as scan; up: close / previous close >= 1.04; down: close / previous close <= 0.96
measurement_rules.breadth_ratios: sum(up4) / sum(down4), only for a full 5 or 10 dated sessions with nonzero coverage on every day and a nonzero denominator; coverage may vary
measurement_rules.volume_vs_average: current volume / mean volume of previous 20 contiguous sessions
measurement_rules.range_expansion: current (high-low)/close / mean((high-low)/close) over previous 7 contiguous sessions
measurement_rules.compression_ratio: mean((high-low)/close) over latest 7 sessions / mean((high-low)/close) over the preceding 60; 67 contiguous sessions required
measurement_rules.close_position: (close-low)/(high-low), from 0 to 1; null for a zero range
measurement_rules.prior_up_days: consecutive higher closes ending on the previous session; null if available history ends before the streak does
measurement_rules.trend_intensity: mean(close) over latest 7 / mean(close) over latest 65, including current session
measurement_rules.prior_bursts_20: canonical scan matches over previous 20 sessions; not the discretionary count of setups since a trend began
measurement_rules.base_down4_count: close-to-close declines of at least 4% over previous 7 sessions, regardless of volume
measurement_rules.base_range_pct: 100 * (highest high - lowest low over previous 7 sessions) / previous close
measurement_rules.prior_day_move_pct: previous session close-to-close change in percent
measurement_rules.calendar: scanner previous-session decision for current day; cross-frame observed calendar for history, with any printed immediately preceding weekday retained; missing bars are not bridged
